_about: Lockheed L-1011 Maintenance Manual, 6-10-00 Figure 1: page index 8, layers.py --mode image --threshold 150 at scale 4, clip 90,370,540,640 (front). Pixels of that raster, line centres; the right half as drawn (the aircraft's left side). Drawn at the side view's scale (its printed 155 ft 4 in span over the drawn 1524 px: 32.19 px a meter). The fuselage's top is under the intake's fairing (a free point). The tailplane is the pair of lines meeting at its tip 10.9 m out (upper level, lower rising); the wing's lines run below it. The centre intake's ring is drawn larger than the side view's lip and the plan's fairing (both about 2.4 m), and than the printed 8 ft 3.25 in: it's placed as free points from the side view's lip (top and bottom tied to the crown) and the plan's width. The side nacelle's inlet ring is drawn 2.67 m tall (as the side view's nacelle, 2.66 m, and the printed 8 ft 10 in, 2.692 m) but only 2.45 m across: it's placed as a circle of the drawn height on the drawn ring's middle (free points).
